suite: Core Filing E08-E12 acceptance-criteria -> prototype-state traceability
source_of_acceptance_criteria: Jira story descriptions synced from LegalSaathi_PRD_v0.3/v0.4.2

entries.ac: Vetting checklist includes draft, annexures, fee readiness, and client approval
Final bundle is stored with hash and version ID
Case advances only after checklist completion
Locked version cannot be edited; any change creates a new version
AI suggestions remain non-binding (compliance)
Filing entry captures court, date, mode, proof, and notes
Timeline shows File in Court stage complete
Milestone engine checks Case Filed 25% trigger
Case Filed milestone invoice requires lawyer/billing approval
Filing proof upload required where available
Recording a filing does not assert court acceptance (compliance)
Diary number appears in case header and timeline
User can attach court receipt or acknowledgement
Change history preserves old and new values
Value validated only where court/source rule configured
Client notification is lawyer-approved
No official-validation claim without authorised source (compliance)
Ledger distinguishes professional fee, court/process fee, reimbursement, and tax fields
Receipt upload is linked to the fee line item
Client statement reflects paid/pending/refunded status
Payment proof/receipt required for paid status
Fee can be offset against advance or requested from client
GST/SAC and reimbursement classification require finance review (LCR-007/008)
Case header displays case number/CNR with source and last updated timestamp
Court-data polling is enabled only after identifier validation
Errors show fallback/manual update route
CNR user-entered or fetched only through permitted sources
Data freshness and source are visible
eCourts integration must comply with TOS + legal review; no captcha/access bypass (LCR-009)
